assignments.briefing: Hold the designated planet, complete the required number of operations, and terminate the mandated quantity of Illuminate hostiles in order to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.
assignments.title: MAJOR ORDER

dispatches.message: MAJOR ORDER ADJUSTMENT Ongoing analysis of current major order has identified a reprioritization of objectives. Helldivers are called to immediately assist SEAF in the defense of Senge-23 by culling huge swaths of illuminates. The target for mission operations is deprioritized.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Following Illuminate interference against Class A elder statespersons, High Command has authorized the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative. For every Illuminate terminated during this order, this vital charitable fund will receive 0.004 Super Credits. Helldivers: hold SENGE 23, complete 1,250,000 operations and kill 1,000,000,000 Illuminate forces to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.

MAJOR ORDER WON Thanks to the Helldivers' steadfast obedience, the chemical safety demonstration on SENGE 23 has concluded with the successful defense of the planet from further Illuminate interference. Additionally, a complete recalibration of SEAF aerosol payloads has resulted in Class A retirees happily reporting an immediate improvement to their well-deserved scenic views, and an abundance of pristine, pine-scented air.

STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE FAILED Despite the Helldivers overcoming the Automatons on MARFARK, the heartless machines retained their foul communist propaganda arrays on MENKENT, broadcasting obscene lies regarding the safety of SEAF chemical peacekeeping operations. The Ministry of Truth has proactively suspended all civilian broadcasts until speech is correctly free once more, and has escorted any citizen cruelly exposed to the signal to voluntary acoustic re-education facilities.

WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory.

NEW STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE Automatons are attacking MENKENT and MARFARK, and worse, broadcasting vile lies claiming defensive gas strikes on SENGE 23 harmed Super Earth citizens. Helldivers: liberate MARFARK, targeted by the Incineration Corps, and MENKENT, targeted by the Jet Brigade to forcibly deny these baseless, unlawful socialist fabrications—and their craven falsehoods.

NEW MAJOR ORDER The Illuminate have manipulated harmless gaseous residues into somehow affecting exclusive Class A retirement facilities orbiting SENGE 23. To prove the safety of Eagle Gas Storms—normally entirely benevolent to human lungs—Helldivers must hold SENGE 23, and deploy to the Terminid front to eliminate 30,000,000 Bile Spewers and 40,000,000 Bile Spitters, to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.

MAJOR ORDER WON The liberation of SENGE 23 has concluded with a decisive victory for the Helldivers. High-definition broadcasts of the engagement were successfully transmitted to cheering homes across the Federation, prompting an immediate 4.2% increase in regional real estate futures. As a routine operational byproduct, harmless gaseous residues are now dispersing into adjacent residential flight corridors. Air quality experts have decisively concluded there is no cause for concern.

DSS MAINTENANCE UPDATE Unforeseable supply line disruptions are preventing Helldiver contributions to DSS Tactical Actions from being received. The issue is currently being addressed and will be resolved in an appropriately expedient manner unworthy of complaint. Personnel are advised to avoid contribution to the DSS and undue contemplation or communication about this issue until normal operation is restored. Violations will be appropriately logged in the violator's permanent files.
TERREK is under attack by the Terminids! All Helldivers must deploy immediately to defend it!

NEW MAJOR ORDER Shattered Illuminate divisions are consolidating on SENGE 23. High Command has authorized a live broadcast of their imminent eradication to every loyal home. To bolster this initative, the recently restored DSS (Democracy Space Station) has deployed, newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm to enable widespread chemical peacekeeping. Liberate SENGE 23 and eliminate 400,000,000 Illuminate hostiles.

DSS MAINTENANCE UPDATE The Democracy Space Station has been offline for recalibration. Engineers have been altering the functionality of the Eagle Storm Tactical Action, in collaboration with C.O.B. Genetics, to deploy aerosol-based deterrents. The DSS has been returned to operational service.

MAJOR ORDER WON Buoyed by inspiring footage of the Federation's greatest heroes decimating its greatest enemies, Maelstrom Tank sales to the public have skyrocketed. Citizens are clamoring for the opportunity to defend their homes and families with their very own Tank. The Maelstrom Tank is available for Helldiver use in perpetuity.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Unrelenting enemy aggression has put production of the Maelstrom Tank in jeopardy. To recoup costs, the Helldivers are ordered to aid the creation of a public awareness sales campaign. Footage of the Helldivers obliterating Freedom's enemies could increase pre-sales, providing the funding needed to save the project. GATRIA and WASAT have just come under attack. Deploy to defend these planets, utilizing the Maelstrom Tank.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED Insufficient materials have been harvested by the Helldivers to fulfill production quotas for deluxe Maelstrom Tank features. This has caused significant distress amongst the early investors who were promised these features as incentives, resulting in a precipitous drop in pre-sales and a decrease in share value. As a result, the Maelstrom Tank project is now at risk of termination.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Production of Maelstrom Tanks for civilian and military use is proceeding on schedule. Now, deluxe features offered as incentives for early investors must be fabricated. The Helldivers are ordered to dismantle 5,000,000 Automaton Tanks to repurpose their engine cooling systems as climate-controlled cupholders, and harvest 25,000,000 Chargers to convert their carapaces to vibration-insulation panels.

MAJOR ORDER WON The Helldivers liberated PHACT BAY and MARFARK. AM Defense has already broken ground on massive factories for large-scale Maelstrom Tank fabrication. Pre-orders from qualifying citizens for home defense Tanks have already sold out, evidencing the eagerness of Super Earth citizens to exercise their natural-born freedoms.
STRATEGIC ALERT The Automaton Incineration Corps has been reported on VINDEMITARIX PRIME.

MINOR TERMINID OUTBREAK A minor Terminid outbreak has occured on FRONTERIA. It is evident that some dissidents continue their hopeless effort to disrupt citizen confidence in the TCS+. The Helldivers are ordered to put down this small, low-threat outbreak.
NEW MAJOR ORDER Enemy aggression prevents the long-term construction of the new Maelstrom Tank, threatening our citizens' inherent right to self-defense. Liberate MARFARK and PHACT BAY immediately.

STRATEGIC UPDATE Miscalibrations in the Democracy Space Station have required it to be taken temporarily offline in order to be resolved. The Ministry of Defense has shifted significant personnel to these fixes, making it a top priority. Those responsible for the mistakes will attend an intensive re-training seminar. If the issue persists, their families will also attend the seminar.

CAMPAIGN FAILURE Cyborg interference has raised significant doubts in the veracity of the Quarter-Term Elections. As a result, a re-vote has been ordered, with enhanced election security measures to make interference impossible. SEAF Battalions have been recalled from the frontlines to secure voting sites.

tacticalActions.name: EAGLE STORM
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Deploys periodic Eagle Gas Strikes during missions. Slows enemy progress in Defense Campaigns.

tacticalActions.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet. The Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.

tacticalActions.name: HEAVY ORDNANCE DISTRIBUTION
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Gives access to the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage stratagem during missions. Accelerates progress in Liberation Campaigns.

active_campaign.title: EPIC PURGE
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: With the restored Democracy Space Station back in active duty and newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm Tactical Action, the Helldivers must demonstrate their full control over the Illuminate to reassure citizens, and confirm the absolute safety of chemical peacekeeping operations.
active_campaign.description_cn: 随着修复后的民主空间站重新投入使用，并新装备了鹰式毒气风暴战略配备，绝地潜兵必须展示他们对光能者的全面控制，以安抚公民，并确认化学维和行动的绝对安全。

phases.title: CHEMICAL PEACEKEEPING
phases.briefing:
Following the Helldivers' victory in collapsing the Void, SEAF Intelligence indicates shattered Illuminate divisions are consolidating ground assets on SENGE 23. High Command has authorized a live broadcast of their imminent eradication to every loyal home to reassure domestic investors and inspire children.

To bolster this initative, the recently restored DSS (Democracy Space Station) has deployed, newly equipped with the Eagle Gas Storm to enable widespread chemical peacekeeping.

Helldivers are ordered to liberate SENGE 23 and eliminate 400,000,000 Illuminate hostiles to secure the sector.
phases.briefing_cn:
在绝地潜兵瓦解寂域的胜利之后，SEAF情报显示，支离破碎的光能者师团正在新戈23上整合地面资产。超级地球最高司令部已授权向每个忠诚的家庭直播其即将被消灭的过程，以安抚国内投资者并激励儿童。

为支持这一行动，最近修复的DSS（民主空间站）已部署，并新装备了鹰式毒气风暴，以实现广泛的化学维和。

绝地潜兵被命令解放新戈23并消灭400,000,000名光能者敌人，以保障该星区。

phases.title: BIO-SAMPLE CULLING
phases.briefing:
In a show of their depravity, the Illuminate have knowingly altered the harmless gaseous residues dissipating from SENGE 23 into somehow affecting exclusive Class A retirement facilities orbiting the planet.

This reckless manipulation of defensive gas strikes—normally entirely benevolent to human lungs—has caused visual obfuscation in residents' private docking bays, minor respiratory irritation, and a sharp rise in unauthorized leave for facility staff.

To prove the safety of Eagle Gas Storms, Helldivers must hold SENGE 23, and deploy to the Terminid front to eliminate 30,000,000 Bile Spewers and 40,000,000 Bile Spitters, to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.
phases.briefing_cn:
光能者以其堕落行径，蓄意将新戈23散逸的无害气体残留物加以改造，使其以某种方式影响到环绕该行星运行的专属A级退休设施。

这种对防御性毒气打击——通常对人类肺部完全无害——的鲁莽操控，已导致居民私人停靠舱内出现视觉模糊、轻微呼吸道刺激，以及设施工作人员擅离职守现象急剧上升。

为证明鹰式毒气风暴的安全性，绝地潜兵必须守住新戈23，并部署至终结族前侧，消灭30,000,000只胆汁喷涌虫和40,000,000只胆汁喷吐虫，以协助对空气传播毒性开展至关重要且已全面规划的研究。

phases.title: RESTITUTION HARVEST
phases.briefing:
Following rigorous field validation and formula recalibration, the Ministry of Defense and Ministry of Truth proudly confirm that—for all who hold Liberty dear to their heart—the Eagle Gas Storm is now even safer than it already was, the patented formula demonstrably only targeting alien flesh and treasonous lungs.

However, the impact of recent Illuminate interference on Class A elder statespersons cannot go unanswered. High Command has therefore authorised the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative. For every Illuminate terminated during this order, 0.004 Super Credits will be donated to this vital tax-deductible charitable fund.

Helldivers: hold SENGE 23, complete 1,250,000 operations and kill 1,000,000,000 Illuminate forces to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.
phases.briefing_cn:
经过严格的实地验证与配方重新校准，国防部与真理部自豪地确认——对于所有心怀自由之人——鹰式毒气风暴如今比以往更加安全，其专利配方经证实仅针对异星血肉与叛国者的肺腑。

然而，近期光能者干扰对A级元老造成的冲击绝不可置之不理。超级地球最高司令部因此批准了AIR（反光能者补偿）计划。在此命令期间，每消灭一个光能者，将有0.004超级信用点被捐入这一至关重要的、可抵税慈善基金。

绝地潜兵：守住新戈23，完成1,250,000次行动并消灭1,000,000,000名光能者部队，以恢复我们最受敬重的退休人员的心神安宁与完整呼吸弹匣容量。

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Hold the designated planet, complete the required number of operations, and terminate the mandated quantity of Illuminate hostiles in order to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.
major_order.translated_brief: 守住指定行星，完成规定次数的行动，并歼灭指定数量的光能者敌军，以此让我们最受敬重的退休人员重获心安与完整的呼吸能力。
